meta.name: qwen3-tts-apple-silicon
meta.description: Local Qwen3-TTS on Apple Silicon using MLX. Use when generating Chinese speech, testing Qwen3-TTS voices, selecting built-in speakers, applying style instructions, cloning a voice from reference audio, or designing a new voice from text descriptions on this Mac. Best for local/offline TTS, Apple Silicon/MLX validation, prompt-to-speech generation, and reusable dubbing workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在本地 Apple 设备上用 MLX 生成中文语音
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Mac 上离线生成中文语音或克隆声音
copy.tagline_en: Generate Chinese speech locally on Apple Silicon using MLX
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need offline Chinese TTS or voice cloning on a Mac

howto.what: Claude 能通过本地脚本生成中文语音，支持选择预置发言人、克隆参考音频的声音，或根据文字描述设计新音色。
howto.when: 当你说出需要生成中文语音、克隆声音或设计新声音时触发。

say.text: 用默认发言人合成一段中文语音。
say.note: 会调用默认发言人 serena 生成 wav 文件。

say.text: 根据这段参考音频克隆声音。
say.note: 需要提供参考音频和对应文字。
会使用 1.7B 模型生成新音色。

howto.what_en: Claude can generate Chinese speech locally via a script, supporting preset speakers, voice cloning from reference audio, or designing a new voice from text descriptions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to generate Chinese speech, clone a voice, or design a new voice.

say_en.text: Synthesize Chinese speech with the default speaker.
say_en.note: Calls default speaker serena to produce a wav file.

say_en.text: Clone this voice from the reference audio.
say_en.note: Requires reference audio and its transcription.
Uses the 1.7B model to create a new timbre.
